synopsis: Just as Haruchika Isezaki was confessing to his first love, he is suddenly summoned to another world. These girls have lost their ability to love due to a curse cast by the Demon Lord. In other words, Haruchika must convince them all to fall in love with him! To return to his world and hear the answer to his confession, Haruchika accepts this mission and sets out to save another world through love.
